definitions.explanation: Having graduated from a prestigious or high-level educational institution, typically a well-known university. In Japanese society, often specifically refers to having attended a top-tier university.

examples.japanese: {高学歴|こうがくれき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a workplace with many highly educated people.

examples.japanese: {高学歴|こうがくれき}だ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Having a high educational background doesn't necessarily mean one is good at their job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高学歴|こうがくれき}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan is sometimes called a credential-oriented society.

notes: A compound of ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) + ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧ (educational background/academic credentials). Antonym: {低学歴|ていがくれき} (low educational background). Related terms: ⟦{学歴社会|がくれきしゃかい}→学歴社会：18893_gakurekishakai⟧ (credential-oriented society), ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧⟦フィルター→フィルター：21847_firutaa⟧ (academic credential filter, informal screening by university prestige in hiring). In Japan, {高学歴|こうがくれき} typically implies graduation from a well-known university rather than simply having an advanced degree.
